Position-specific traits show forwards prioritize leanness for agility, while midfielders require both strength and endurance for wide-ranging coverage. Isometric strength correlates moderately with jumping and kicking, suggesting that pure strength training alone is insufficient; instead, integrated power development is needed. Finally, statistical differences confirm that midfielders possess superior overall physical capacity, aligning with their central role requiring stamina and power. Together, these primitives establish a comprehensive framework for tailoring training regimens to optimize performance and close the gap with international standards.
